## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **mxtp-Setup.exe** | Installer: Start menu and desktop shortcuts, plus "Open with Zudio HD" for music files. |
| **mxtp.exe** | Portable: runs straight away, with nothing to install. |
| **mxtp-build-it-yourself.zip** | The source with **build.bat**. Unzip it and double-click build.bat to build both exes on your own PC. |

The exes aren't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC" the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Bug reports and ideas are welcome in Issues.
